privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how PR NEWS ('we', 'us', 'our') collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information through our platform at prnews.ca and related services.

sections.title: 1. Overview
sections.content: We act as the controller of personal information processed through the PR NEWS platform. We are committed to compliance with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and, where applicable, Quebec's Law 25.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, company name, billing details, and press release content. We also collect technical information including IP address, browser type, and device information through standard server logs.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your information to create and manage your account, process payments, distribute press releases, provide customer support, enforce our Terms of Service, and comply with legal obligations. We may also send transactional emails and service announcements.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis and Consent
sections.content: By creating an account or subscribing, you consent to the processing described in this policy. You may withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time by using the unsubscribe link in our emails.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Processors
sections.content:
We rely on the following service providers to operate the platform: Stripe for payment processing; Resend for email delivery; Vercel for application hosting and Blob storage; and the PostgreSQL database host configured in your deployment (for example Supabase, AWS RDS, Neon, or Vercel Postgres). We only share personal information necessary for these providers to perform their services.

Each processor is bound by a contract that requires appropriate security and confidentiality measures. You should also review the privacy policies of these providers for details on how they handle data.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: Account and billing information is retained for as long as your account is active and for seven (7) years afterward to meet tax and legal obligations. Press release content is retained while published and may remain in backup archives for up to one (1) year after deletion.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.content:
At launch, PR NEWS does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Only essential session and security cookies (such as those required for login and CSRF protection) are used.

If we add analytics or advertising scripts in the future, we will obtain your consent through a cookie banner before loading them. See our Cookie/Consent hook in src/lib/analytics.ts for the integration point.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
sections.content: Under PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25, you have the right to access, correct, delete, and port your personal information. You also have the right to withdraw consent and to file a complaint with the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

sections.title: 9. Data Subject Access Requests
sections.content: To request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information, email us at privacy@prnews.ca. We will respond within thirty (30) days and may request identity verification before fulfilling your request.

sections.title: 10. Security
sections.content: We use industry-standard measures including encryption in transit (TLS), hashed passwords, and access controls. No system is completely secure; you are responsible for keeping your account credentials safe.

sections.title: 11. Children's Privacy
sections.content: PR NEWS is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify users of material changes by email or by posting a notice on the platform.

sections.title: 13. Contact
sections.content: For privacy questions or data subject requests, contact us at privacy@prnews.ca.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your access to and use of the PR NEWS platform, website, and services ('Services'). By creating an account, subscribing, or using the Services, you agree to these Terms.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using PR NEWS, you represent that you have the authority to agree to these Terms and that you will comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

sections.title: 2. Account Registration
sections.content: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity under your account.

sections.title: 3. Use of Services
sections.content: You may use the Services only for lawful purposes. You may not attempt to access restricted areas, interfere with other users, or misuse the platform's infrastructure.

sections.title: 4. Content and License
sections.content:
You retain ownership of the press releases, images, and other content you submit ('Your Content'). By submitting Your Content, you grant PR NEWS a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide license to distribute, display, and reproduce it through our network for the purpose of providing the Services.

You confirm that you have the right to grant this license and that Your Content does not infringe any third-party rights.

sections.title: 5. Prohibited Content
sections.content: You may not submit content that is illegal, defamatory, fraudulent, hateful, discriminatory, infringing, or otherwise harmful. We reserve the right to refuse or remove any content and to suspend accounts that violate this policy.

sections.title: 6. Payments and Subscriptions
sections.content: Payments are processed through Stripe. Subscription fees are billed in advance; one-time release fees are charged at checkout. You may cancel your subscription through the billing portal or by contacting us. Fees are non-refundable unless required by law.

sections.title: 7. Service Levels
sections.content: We aim to complete editorial review within two (2) business hours for standard submissions and one (1) hour for Growth subscribers. Distribution timing depends on the target outlets and any embargo you set.

sections.title: 8. Termination
sections.content: We may suspend or terminate your account for violation of these Terms or for non-payment. You may delete your account at any time; upon deletion, your press releases may be removed from public pages but may persist in backups and distribution partner caches.

sections.title: 9. Disclaimer of Warranties
sections.content: The Services are provided 'as is' and 'as available' without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee pickup by any media outlet or specific audience reach.

sections.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, PR NEWS shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for lost profits or revenue, arising out of or related to your use of the Services.

sections.title: 11. Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms are governed by the laws of Ontario, Canada, and any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Toronto, Ontario, without regard to conflict of law principles.

sections.title: 12. Changes to These Terms
sections.content: We may modify these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the site and, where appropriate, notified by email. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

sections.title: 13. Contact
sections.content: For questions about these Terms, contact us at legal@prnews.ca.

casl.title: CASL Compliance
casl.intro: PR NEWS complies with Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL). This page describes our practices for sending commercial electronic messages (CEMs) and managing consent.
practices: Consent: We only send CEMs to individuals who have provided express or implied consent to receive them. Consent is recorded at the time of signup or subscription.
Identification: Every CEM clearly identifies PR NEWS as the sender and includes our current mailing address and a way to contact us.
Unsubscribe: Every marketing and promotional email includes a one-click unsubscribe link. Requests are processed within ten (10) business days or immediately through the automated link.
No unsolicited automated distribution: We do not add purchased or scraped contacts to our lists.
Record keeping: Consent records, unsubscribe requests, and sender identification details are retained for at least three (3) years from the date of the message, in line with CASL guidance.
casl.contact: For CASL-related questions, contact us at casl@prnews.ca.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: PR NEWS is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards.

sections.title: Conformance Status
sections.content: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) defines requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. It defines three levels of conformance: Level A, Level AA, and Level AAA. PR NEWS is partially conformant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Partially conformant means that some parts of the content do not fully conform to the accessibility standard.
